Karunya Lottery Result 2026: Prize Details

Karunya is one of the seven weekly lotteries. Karunya lottery draw is held every Saturday at 3 pm. Every lottery is represented by an alphabetical code, and the Karunya lottery code is “KR”, which represents the draw number along with the code. The Karunya lottery costs Rs. 50/-.

Kerala State Lotteries Department releases the lottery in 12 series, and the series may vary. 108 lakh tickets were issued every week for sale. The first prize winner got 1 Crore Rupees
